title: Germany: Economy & Population
description: Germany: CPI/food inflation, unemployment, house prices, population and demographics, life expectancy, fertility, consumer/producer confidence, government bond yield and bank interest rates — via Eurostat and ECB, since 2000 where the data goes back that far.

targets.rawSql: SELECT value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='cpi_inflation_pct' AND source='eurostat' ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='food_cpi_inflation_pct' AND source='eurostat' ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='unemployment_rate_pct' AND source='eurostat' ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='house_price_index' AND source='eurostat' ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='population_total' AND source='eurostat' ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='consumer_confidence_index' AND source='eurostat' ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT period_date AS time, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='cpi_index' AND source='eurostat' AND period_date >= '2000-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1

SELECT period_date AS time, indicator AS metric, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator IN ('cpi_inflation_pct','food_cpi_inflation_pct') AND source='eurostat' AND period_date >= '2000-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1

SELECT period_date AS time, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='unemployment_rate_pct' AND source='eurostat' AND period_date >= '2000-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: House price index (2015=100)
panels.description: Quarterly. Not every quarter is published for every country at the same lag.

targets.rawSql: SELECT period_date AS time, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='house_price_index' AND source='eurostat' AND period_date >= '2000-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1

SELECT period_date AS time, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='population_total' AND source='eurostat' AND period_date >= '2000-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1

SELECT period_date AS time, indicator AS metric, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator IN ('births','deaths') AND source='eurostat' AND period_date >= '2000-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Net migration, per year
panels.description: Eurostat's net migration plus statistical adjustment.

targets.rawSql: SELECT period_date AS time, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='net_migration' AND source='eurostat' AND period_date >= '2000-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1

SELECT period_date AS time, indicator AS metric, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator IN ('consumer_confidence_index','producer_confidence_index') AND source='eurostat' AND period_date >= '2000-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1
SELECT value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='life_expectancy_years_total' AND source='eurostat' ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='fertility_rate_children_per_woman' AND source='eurostat' ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Avg. age of mother at childbirth

targets.rawSql: SELECT value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='avg_mother_age_years' AND source='eurostat' ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='net_migration' AND source='eurostat' ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Life expectancy at birth, by gender

targets.rawSql: SELECT period_date AS time, indicator AS metric, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator IN ('life_expectancy_years_men','life_expectancy_years_women') AND source='eurostat' AND period_date >= '2000-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Total fertility rate
panels.description: Eurostat demo_find, annual. 2.1 is roughly the replacement rate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT period_date AS time, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='fertility_rate_children_per_woman' AND source='eurostat' AND period_date >= '2000-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1

SELECT period_date AS time, indicator AS metric, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator IN ('unemployment_rate_pct_men','unemployment_rate_pct_women') AND source='eurostat' AND period_date >= '2000-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1

SELECT period_date AS time, indicator AS metric, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator IN ('unemployment_rate_pct_youth','unemployment_rate_pct') AND source='eurostat' AND period_date >= '2000-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 10-year government bond yield
panels.description: ECB long-term interest rate for convergence purposes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT period_date AS time, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator='gov_bond_10y_pct' AND source='ecb' AND period_date >= '2000-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Bank interest rates (what banks actually report to the ECB)
panels.description: ECB MIR statistics — new-business mortgage rate vs. what banks pay on savings and term deposits. Not government bond yields.

targets.rawSql: SELECT period_date AS time, indicator AS metric, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='DEU' AND indicator IN ('bank_mortgage_rate_pct','bank_savings_rate_pct','bank_term_deposit_rate_pct') AND source='ecb' AND period_date >= '2000-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1
